note: Message Subscribe Email gates the email notifier per subscription. It ships email_* flags paired to subscribe_* flags (email_node/email_term/email_user), a boolean user field message_subscribe_email ('Email subscriptions', default on), config message_subscribe_email.settings:flag_prefix (default 'email', has schema), a FlagEvents subscriber that auto-flags the matching email_* flag when the user subscribes (if their field is on), hook_message_subscribe_get_subscribers_alter() that adds/removes the 'email' notifier based on the email_* flagging, hook_flag_action_access() forbidding an email_* flag without the paired subscribe_* flag, and message_subscribe_email.manager::getFlags(). On install it repoints the UI subscription views to *_email variants. Requires message_subscribe_ui. Medium cases read back live config/flags; hard cases enable an email flag / repoint a view and verify live state.

evals.prompt: How does the Message Subscribe Email submodule decide which of a user's subscriptions actually send an email, rather than emailing about everything they subscribed to?
evals.expected_output: It adds a parallel set of email_* flags (email_node, email_term, email_user) paired to the subscribe_* flags. Only subscriptions that also hold the matching email_* flag get the 'email' notifier; hook_message_subscribe_get_subscribers_alter() adds the email notifier for those users and removes it for the rest.

evals.prompt: In Message Subscribe Email, what controls whether a user's new subscriptions are set to email them by default?
evals.expected_output: A boolean field on the user account, machine name message_subscribe_email, labelled 'Email subscriptions' (default on). When it is on, the FlagEvents subscriber auto-adds the matching email_* flag whenever the user subscribes; when off, subscribing does not email-flag the item.

evals.prompt: Which Message Subscribe hook does the email submodule implement to make sure only email subscribers get the email notifier, and what does it do to the others?
evals.expected_output: hook_message_subscribe_get_subscribers_alter(). It looks up which recipients hold a relevant email_* flag for the context, adds the 'email' notifier to those recipients (addNotifier('email')) and removes it from everyone else (removeNotifier('email')).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which flag-name prefix does Message Subscribe Email currently use to identify its email flags? Inspect the live configuration and give the exact prefix.
evals.expected_output: notify. The live message_subscribe_email.settings config has flag_prefix set to 'notify' (so it would look for notify_* email flags instead of the default email_*).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which Message Subscribe Email flag (email_*) is currently enabled? Inspect the live flag configuration and name it.
evals.expected_output: email_term. It is the only enabled email_* flag on the site (email_node and email_user are disabled).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable the Message Subscribe Email flag that lets users opt into email notifications for content (node) subscriptions. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the email_node flag (Structure > Flags, or load the 'email_node' flag and call ->enable()->save()). It is the email_* partner of subscribe_node, so email-flagging content becomes possible.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the subscribe_node subscription listing in the Subscriptions UI use the email-aware view that Message Subscribe Email provides (the one that shows the email toggle), i.e. subscribe_node_email (display default). Apply the change to the live flag.
evals.expected_output: Set the subscribe_node flag's third-party setting message_subscribe_ui.view_name to 'subscribe_node_email:default' (this is what message_subscribe_email does on install). Via the flag edit form's 'View to use' select, or setThirdPartySetting('message_subscribe_ui','view_name','subscribe_node_email:default')->save().
